detail.longDescription:
Following YouTube channels costs you ads, tracking and a Google login.

Invidious is an open source YouTube front end: watch, subscribe, make playlists, no YouTube account. We run a public instance. Bring in your YouTube or NewPipe subscriptions and videos start with no ad first.

https://blog.whiteravens.net/2026/11/18/invidious-youtube-subscriptions-without-the-ads-or-a-google-account.html?ref=mastodon
